description: Calculate replenishment from this enterprise's inventory, incoming purchases, sales demand, and backlog, then submit a purchase demand to the upstream exchange.
mode_confirmation: Use is_beer_game_mode and action_constraints from procurement.json.policy_context, trade_decision_card.policy_context, or blackboard.policy_context_by_department.procurement. Prefer this beer_game replenishment action only when is_beer_game_mode is true and create_replenishment_order is allowed.
conditions: In beer_game mode, downstream demand must be translated into orders at the next upstream tier.

trade_decision_card.delta.pressure_changes, procurement.self_state.operational_summary.inventory_position_by_material, or the sales confirmed/stale backlog fields show downstream demand, overdue commitments, an insufficient inventory position, or recent demand growth.

If procurement.self_state.recipe_recovery_signal_by_material or blackboard.departments.production.recovery_material_shortages identifies a critical material, prioritize it and other critical materials in the same recipe for replenishment.
Prioritize replenishment when blackboard.departments.sales.confirmed_order_backlog_quantity or stale_backlog_quantity rises substantially.
Inventory position is below target or safety stock is needed to meet delivery dates.
parameter_constraints: Choose material_id first from procurement.self_state.operational_summary.inventory_position_by_material. Fall back to a real product ID in this enterprise's inventory or sales demand only if primary inputs are insufficient.
Use 1 to 3 target_inventory_days unless real backlog has risen substantially.
Derive safety_stock from actual demand, backlog, or inventory risk; do not inflate it without evidence.
Derive expected_daily_demand primarily from canonical primary inputs. Only if those are insufficient, consult historical orders, analysis, or operational_summary.latest_replenishment_by_material.
When creating action.json from this template, action_param may contain only fields listed in required_parameters or optional_parameters; include every required field and no unlisted fields.
Never add supplier_id, supplier_name, supplier_type, supplier, or supplier_reference. The system selects suppliers using the enterprise's upstream exchange and supplier matrix.
constraints: Use only this enterprise's local information; do not use another enterprise's actual inventory or a global demand series.
Prefer this action over guessing create_purchase_demand.quantity manually.
If operational_summary.inventory_position_by_material exists, use its on_hand, incoming, backlog, and inventory_position to decide whether to replenish.
If trade_decision_card.delta.pressure_changes exists, check changes in inventory_position, backlog, and incoming for the target material_id before replenishing.
Treat a nonempty linked_products or critical_bottleneck_products in procurement.self_state.recipe_recovery_signal_by_material[material_id] as high-priority evidence for recovery replenishment.
If blackboard.departments.production.recovery_material_shortages points to this material_id, raise its replenishment priority under otherwise equal conditions.
Replenish multiple materials in the same finished-product recipe against a common recovery target; avoid fixing one shortage only to be blocked by another material.
When backlog is separated into confirmed_order_backlog, proposal_backlog, and stale_backlog, treat confirmed and stale backlog as stronger evidence of real replenishment pressure.
Do not double-count noncanonical backlog detail fields as separate primary demand signals.
A replenishment recommendation of zero succeeds without creating an exchange request.
